purpose: Preserve five cross-domain external research introductions sent only after Gmail anti-duplicate review, with one narrow scientific object per recipient and explicit next gates.

messages.subject: Request for adversarial review: endpoint-compression DP for finite-field subspace arrangements
messages.request: Identify directly subsuming prior art, proof defect, cleaner known formulation, or independently implement the frozen DP.

messages.subject: Request for statistical critique of an anytime-valid independent-future evidence protocol
messages.request: Attack history-wise point-probability assumptions, filtration/predictability, multiplicity, e-process validity, optional stopping and selection.

messages.subject: Question on using a predetermined future drand round for an auditable preregistered benchmark
messages.request: Confirm appropriate use of a predetermined future drand round and specify chain, key, signature, freshness and archival metadata for long-term independent verification.

messages.subject: Research feedback request: low-bandwidth input -> editable semantic graph for AAC/BCI communication
messages.request: Define meaningful AAC/BCI benchmark outcomes, user-control safeguards and participatory-design requirements for comparing conventional AAC, AI autocomplete and editable semantic graph interaction.

messages.subject: Research data request: blind sonar reconstruction benchmark using RMS Titanic survey truth
messages.request: Obtain raw/near-raw or highest-fidelity calibrated sonar products and calibration/navigation/acoustic metadata sufficient for a blind localization and reconstruction benchmark.

reply_watch.behavior: Notify only on substantive replies; summarize reply, classify it, state evidence/gate impact and recommend the next concrete step.
